Level 6 of task-0b529a18 is solved. It took 45 actions against a human baseline of 49, so the cost is below baseline.

**How the game works:**
- A click in empty space moves the active token, the 0-circle with a 4 in the center. Clicks on the border are ignored. A few clicks near a cross were ignored too.
- Clicking a cross makes it the new token. The old token spot becomes a cross.
- Each group of crosses holds one stack of blobs. The stack sits at the centroid of its crosses and the token. With only two points, that is the midpoint. So to put a stack on a target, I click at "3 × target − the two crosses" (or "2 × target − the cross" with two points).
- A stack picks up any blob it lands on.
- To win, each diamond needs the blobs of its outline colors:
  - 7/6 diamond: the 6 blob alone.
  - f/e/9 diamond: the f, e and 9 blobs.
  - b/6/a diamond: the b and a blobs, plus the 6-colored blob the stack started from.

**Wasted actions:** About 25 of the first actions went to finding the rule. Three clicks had no effect: one on the border and two too close to a cross. I also made one wrong placement, when the 9 and f blobs went into the 7/6 diamond.

I saved the full rule and the solution in the global memory `arc_0b529a18_l6_notes`, so a later instance of this game can solve it much faster.
